title: Ties edition
description: A custom resource pack by Ties featuring a new panorama and a clean Mario-style GUI for a fun and colorful Minecraft look.
body:
🎮 What does this project do? 

This resource pack visually enhances Minecraft by adding a custom panorama and a Mario-style graphical user interface. It redesigns menus and screens to create a colorful, playful experience while keeping everything functional and familiar.

⭐ Why download this resource pack?

If you enjoy a bright, fun, and nostalgic Mario-inspired look, this pack is perfect for you. It refreshes the game’s appearance without changing gameplay, making it ideal for both casual and long-term players.

ℹ️ Important information

This is a visual-only resource pack and does not affect game mechanics. It works best with the default Minecraft resolution and can be safely combined with most mods and other resource packs. join my discord to let me know bug reports etc
